Rare earths & critical minerals

Used in permanent magnets, lasers and optics, electronics, alloys and batteries. We supply concentrates and separated products to the specification you give us.

Nd / PrDy / TbY / La / GdTa / NbWTiLi / CoMREC
Forms
Mixed carbonate, concentrates, separated oxides
Purity
Set by the buyer’s specification and confirmed by laboratory assay
Packaging
Steel drums or UN-certified bulk bags, in sealed containers
Verification
ICP-MS assay by an independent laboratory appointed by the buyer
Provenance
OECD due diligence approach to responsible mineral supply chains
Note
Radioactive material classes and export controls apply to some concentrates. We check these before quoting.

Crude oil & petroleum products

Spot and term physical supply for refiners and traders, with terminal lifting, inspection and vessel coordination.

Light sweetMedium / heavyCondensateDieselJet A-1Fuel oil
Grades
As specified, for example by API gravity and sulphur content
Volumes
Cargo parcels from vessel-size lots; term arrangements by agreement
Inspection
Quality and quantity inspection at shore tank and on the vessel by an independent surveyor
Vessels
Tanker chartering support and discharge coordination
Delivery terms
FOB, CFR or CIF for ship cargo, agreed in each contract
Note
Allocation depends on the seller’s licence and the current sanctions position. We do not proceed where either is unclear.
Enquire about this

Gemstones

Rough and cut stones, with sorting, cutting and certification, delivered under secured and insured transport.

DiamondsEmeraldRubySapphireTourmalineAquamarineIndustrial crystals
Forms
Rough parcels, calibrated and cut stones, industrial and optical crystals
Processing
Cleaning, sorting, grading, sawing, cutting, polishing
Certification
Kimberley Process certificate for rough diamonds; independent gemmological reports for stones as requested
Viewing
In a bonded vault or secure room, with your representative present
Transport
Secured courier or vault-to-vault with insurance
Delivery terms
FCA, CIP or DAP, agreed in each contract
